{{Top}}
An '''acoustic signaller''' or '''sound actuator'''<ref name="SWCP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref> was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] part manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. It allowed various droids, including [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwells]] and [[LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer/Legends|LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayers]], to [[Language/Legends|speak]] [[Binary|droid languages]].
